description: Amazon secondary contrasts, 3 splits: E9 - N9 (SIGN real vs rewired) +0.019 +/- 0.006, p 0.57; E5w - E6w (edges in the bigger GraphSAGE) +0.002 +/- 0.014, p 0.75; both not distinguishable from zero
command: uv run scripts/compare_report.py (E9 vs N9, E5w vs E6w; repeats 0-2); uv run scripts/repeat_summary.py --dataset amazon --repeats 3 --prefix pilot_ --pairs g9n3_sign_rw:g9_sign g6w_mlp_big:g5w_sage_big --name sign_and_e5w_controls
notes: N9 (SIGN on the rewired graph) stopped at epoch 1-2 in 14 of 25 fits on split 1 and 7 of 25 on split 2 (none on split 0; E9 at most 1 of 60 per split): an early-stopping failure that lowers N9 and widens the CV deltas (one N9 fold 0.515), so E9 - N9 overstates the real-structure gain and its p is inflated.
